recognize_zh: 高倍可見大量細胞質淡粉紅、核呈卵圓折疊或有核溝的樹突細胞與組織球（interdigitating／Langerhans cell），夾雜小淋巴球與少數嗜酸性球，符合皮膚病性淋巴結病的副皮質區組成。
features: Numerous histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval, folded or grooved vesicular nuclei with delicate chromatin and small nucleoli (interdigitating dendritic and Langerhans cells)
Admixed small mature lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Scattered eosinophils with bright red cytoplasmic granules
No obvious melanin pigment or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in this field
describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node paracortex shows numerous histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved nuclei with fine chromatin, consistent with interdigitating dendritic cells and Langerhans cells. These are admixed with small lymphocytes and scattered eosinophils. Melanin pigment and clusters of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; in patients with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, TCR clonality studies are advised.

ddx.vs: LCH forms confluent sheets of CD1a+ grooved cells, often sinusoidal with eosinophilic abscesses and necrosis, effacing the node.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters of atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic cerebriform nuclei and clonal TCR rearrangement.
IDC sarcoma forms fascicles or whorls of cytologically atypical S100+ cells with effacement, rather than a mixed reactive paracortex.
